summary_brief: 今日（10-06）是9月下旬以来"Agent安全治理+基础设施成熟"主线的深度延续日，无方向性转折。安全主线再度成为绝对焦点：ruvnet/ruflo此役以"插件守卫绕过方式788→0"的清零式成果成为最显著事件，叠加沙箱逃逸、密钥注入拦截、符号链接攻击防护，以及Turborepo安全下载库、Codex Windows安装脚本签名等供应链信任边界建设——这是10-01~10-03安全与治理主线的持续深化而非新爆发。能力端多为既定趋势的推进：工具延迟加载/BM25智能检索（延续10-02）、上下文压缩跨会话状态延续/checkpoint修复（延续10-01/03长会话攻坚）、openclaw原生本地推理运行时（延续10-02"迈向托管运行时"）、多模态模型接入（延续10-03）、Agent可观测与用量账本（延续）。本日真正的新增推进点在易用性与评测纵深：OpenAI落地流式会话首轮即执行本地工具（无需预建会话，降低工具型Agent接入门槛），及ruflo构建2997条跨37守卫的对抗性探针评测框架。科研端延续评测方法论深化（Phoenix TRAIL任务与text-to-SQL提示爬山自动化）。整体定性：从9/18安全沙箱共识、10-01企业级治理，演进至今日"安全威胁建模驱动+供应链信任边界+长会话状态保真"的生产级巩固阶段，ruflo为核心验证场。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 安全治理进入体系化攻坚阶段
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同时对 Agent 运行时的权限边界、沙箱逃逸、密钥注入、插件供应链进行系统性加固，标志着 Agent 安全从零散修补转向威胁建模驱动的体系化治理，是本日最显著的跨类型趋势。

engineering_signals.title: 软件供应链与下载路径安全加固成为共识
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Turborepo 新增带校验和、代理与重定向防护的安全下载库，Codex 对 Windows 安装脚本签名，多个项目升级依赖修复高危漏洞，供应链安全由被动响应转向主动在下载链路建立信任边界。

engineering_signals.title: 大型工具目录下的延迟加载与排序检索成为 Agent 框架标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI agents 与 Codex 同时推进工具搜索的延迟加载与 BM25 排序发现，Deepagents 也实现技能工具按需加载，表明海量工具场景下按需发现已成为 Agent 框架的通用优化方向。

engineering_signals.title: 流式会话中的本地工具执行简化 Agent 构建流程
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI 在 PR 和 Commit 中同时落地流式会话首轮即执行本地工具的能力，允许开发者无需先建会话即可调用工具，显著降低了工具调用型 Agent 的接入门槛，是 Agent SDK 易用性的关键提升。

engineering_signals.title: 上下文压缩跨会话状态延续成为 Agent 长会话关键能力
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 的 compactCarry、Codex 的压缩历史重建完整上下文、LangGraph 的检查点 fork 语义修复，多项目同时解决上下文压缩导致的状态丢失问题，表明长会话 Agent 的持久化状态管理正成为关键工程挑战。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 框架向原生本地推理运行时演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: openclaw 为 worker 落地原生推理运行时并派生自节点模型，同时定义本地推理协议契约；Codex 强制环境必备技能校验，共同指向 Agent 分布式与本地混合推理的自主执行能力方向。

engineering_signals.title: 图像与多模态模型接入全面铺开
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 同日发布 104 个子包，其中 xAI 新增 grok-imagine-image-2.0 图像模型与语音转写、Azure 新增 MAI-Image、FLUX 3 图像生成支持等，配合 Cohere Embed 5 多维度嵌入，反映端侧模型生态向多模态全面扩张。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 运行状态与用量可观测性增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: opencode 将运行中子代理与后台 shell 提升到会话头部，Codex 增加 OTLP 指标时间性偏好，ruflo 新增跨会话 rollup 账本，多项目同时加强 Agent 行为、用量与状态的可观测能力。

research_signals.title: LLM 评测方法论向自动化提示优化与基准拓展演进
research_signals.why_it_matters: Arize-ai/phoenix 同时新增 TRAIL 八项评测任务（含延迟百分位维度）与 text-to-SQL 提示爬山自动优化评测，ruflo 构建 2997 条跨 37 守卫的对抗性探针框架，共同指向评测从静态基准向自动化、对抗性、方法论的纵深研究。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 大规模安全与稳定性修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: 该版本修复了超过100个问题，涵盖权限绕过、沙箱逃逸、符号链接攻击等关键安全漏洞，并增强了插件钩子、子代理和远程会话的稳定性，是Claude Code生态系统的重大加固。

release_signals.title: Promptfoo 模型支持大更新与SDK精简
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增对Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6 Sol/Luna、Grok 4.7等最新模型的评测支持，同时通过将多个SDK改为可选安装来大幅精简依赖，提升性能并降低攻击面。

release_signals.title: Vercel SDK 大规模API重构
release_signals.why_it_matters: 该版本对多个核心API（如Teams、Projects、EdgeConfig）进行了破坏性变更，并新增了AI网关虚拟模型配置、Vercel CI分支列表等新接口，反映了Vercel平台API的演进方向。

release_signals.title: Fabric 新增提示词导出与多提供商支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增--print-prompt模式允许用户在不调用模型的情况下导出最终提示词，便于调试和分享；同时新增Opper、DemonRoute、Firecrawl搜索等提供商支持，扩展了工具的适用范围。

release_signals.title: OpenHands 增强模型路由与语音输入
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增Model Router的'Run at conversation start'开关、批量添加LLM配置文件、语音听写输入等特性，显著提升了Agent Canvas的配置灵活性和交互体验。

release_signals.title: Ruflo 插件安全加固与性能优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: 将插件守卫的绕过方式从788种降至0种，并新增agentTrim等可选优化，在保证安全的同时可节省每会话约4236个token，展示了AI插件生态的安全与效率平衡。

release_signals.title: LangGraph 修复状态分支与DeltaChannel问题
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了多个关于checkpoint分支、DeltaChannel计数器和中断状态报告的核心问题，提升了图状态管理的正确性和可靠性。

release_signals.title: Deepagents 按需加载技能工具
release_signals.why_it_matters: 实现技能工具按需加载，避免在读取技能前加载其全部工具，可显著减少上下文占用和启动延迟，优化多技能场景下的资源利用。

release_signals.title: Codex 修复Windows远程MCP环境变量
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了Windows执行器启动远程stdio MCP服务器时环境变量丢失的问题，确保跨平台开发环境的配置一致性。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 104 个子包（5 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 当日批量发布 104 个工具包，全部为 Patch Changes 例行升级，绝大多数为内部依赖同步与 bug 修复。但部分 Provider 包在补丁中附带真实新能力（新增图像/多模态模型支持、嵌入格式选择、流式用量暴露等），因此并非纯版本同步，而是"例行升级为主 + 少量实质新特性"。本批不含任一 breaking change。批内出现同一包名的多条主版本线同日发布，但各条线均只做 patch 增量。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/xai@5.0.15
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 grok-imagine-image-2.0 图像模型及 auto 画质、1.5k 分辨率、语音转写等多项图像/多模态能力

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/azure@4.0.92
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 MAI-Image 模型支持，扩展了 Azure 图像模型接入能力

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/cohere@4.0.55
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增嵌入格式选择能力，丰富 Cohere Provider 的功能面

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/anthropic@4.0.72
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增通过自定义流式零件暴露 message-start 用量信息，便于用量观测

release_signals.title: vercel/ai ai@7.0.128
release_signals.why_it_matters: 核心包带 `rename evaluate to decide` 及自定义推理分隔符等新能力，作为同批多包引用的源头变更

key_changes: 新增 Model Router 系列功能：支持直接提示词路由、'运行于对话开始'开关、首个路由自动启用'首条消息运行'，并重命名默认为 OpenHands Router Pro/Flash
新增设置功能：支持批量添加 Provider 模型作为 LLM 配置、按连接批量添加 LLM 配置，以及 Agent 配置可自定义人设或额外指令
新增 Canvas 应用功能：支持按事件 ID 替代流式插槽、更新已安装的 Canvas 应用、渲染扩展声明的 SVG 图标
新增聊天功能：支持语音听写输入，改进长回复滚动、编辑器和分支功能体验
新增自动化功能：云端后端支持模板展示、原生 Git 集成、按创建者筛选、内置集成优先于 issue-to-PR 模板，并修复分页和删除确认弹窗等多项问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次发布（v1.25.0）是 OpenHands 一个功能丰富的次要版本更新，重点增强了 Model Router 路由系统、LLM 配置管理、Canvas 应用和自动化功能。新增了语音听写、批量添加 LLM 配置文件、Agent 人设自定义等多项新能力，同时修复了大量前端交互、自动化分页和连接稳定性的问题。此外还包含多项依赖升级、代码重构和文档改进。

## What is in 3.52.1

**Plainly: on npm, this train is a version bump plus a catalog entry.** The three packages (`@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo`) move to 3.52.1 and the plugin catalog gains one entry. Most of what is listed below shipped through the plugin marketplace and the git repo, not through the npm tarballs.

- **Console 0.33.23: band notices.** New `/ruflo band`, `/ruflo notices` and `/ruflo quiet` commands control what the console band shows and how loud it is.
- **Project Anatole (optional `ruflo-protector`, off by default).** It is distributed through the git marketplace and is NOT included in the npm tarballs. Nothing changes unless you install and enable it.
- **Result formatting.** Cleaner formatting of command results in the console.
- **Learning and Router fixes.** Fixes to the Learning pulse and Router behaviour.
- **Bun install fix (#3736).** `bun add ruflo` / `bunx ruflo` now install and run; verified on a clean directory with bun 1.3.13 and npm.

Install: `npx ruflo@latest` (latest, alpha and v3alpha all point at 3.52.1).

key_changes: npm 包版本升级至 3.52.1，插件目录新增一个条目
控制台新增 /ruflo band、/ruflo notices、/ruflo quiet 命令，用于控制横幅显示和提示音量
引入可选功能 Project Anatole（ruflo-protector），默认关闭，通过 git 市场分发
修复 Bun 安装问题（#3736），bun add ruflo / bunx ruflo 现已可正常安装和运行
优化命令结果格式显示，并修复 Learning pulse 和 Router 行为问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: ruflo v3.52.1 主要是一次版本升级，将三个 npm 包统一更新至 3.52.1 并新增一个插件目录条目。本次更新带来了控制台横幅控制命令、可选的安全保护组件（ruflo-protector）等新功能，同时修复了 Bun 环境下的安装问题以及 Learning 和 Router 的相关缺陷。大部分变更通过插件市场和 git 仓库分发，并非全部打包在 npm 中。

新增 TypeSafe Jev provider，支持恢复暂停的 Claude server-tool 轮次、在隔离工作区中运行编码代理
CLI 增强：--filter-metadata 支持逗号分隔的 OR 值，并修复字面逗号处理

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `serverToolUses` to the result of a mod's `turn.step` hook: the tool calls the API ran itself (the advisor), each with its id, name, input, start and end
- Added `agentId` to the `tool.check` event of plugin hooks, so a hook can tell a subagent's permission check from the main session's
- Added `ceiling` to the question and verdict a mod's `tool.check` hook reads, naming the approval an organization requires for a tool
- Added `ThemeKey` and `Color` types to the plugin hooks typings, so an editor lists the theme colors a mod's drawing can name
- Added to `claude plugin validate`: each hook a mod registers at a gating site is listed with whether it has a `.catch` (`gatingHooks` under `--json`)
- Added a Deny button to the Claude apps gateway's sign-in approval page: it ends the pending sign-in, so the waiting terminal stops within seconds
- Added `claude attach <name>` and `claude logs <name>`: part of a session name works in place of the id
- Added `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard <url>` to set up the Managed Agents pattern a page describes as `ant apply` files
- Added `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard <quickstart-name>` to build a Console quickstart template, such as `deep-researcher`, with the `ant` CLI
- Added a warning when a managed settings file is a link to a file outside the managed settings folder
- Added a /status and doctor warning when managed settings ignore user-configured sandbox allowRead paths or allowed domains
- Fixed requests failing behind proxies and gateways that reject one of Claude Code's beta headers with a status other than 400, or together with a second beta
- Fixed long sessions with hundreds of images getting stuck on "Request rejected as unprocessable by the model" errors
- Fixed a turn ending at once when the API's output content filter stopped a reply while Claude was still thinking; the request is now retried once before the error is shown
- Fixed resumed subagents and teammates losing their earlier thinking and prompt cache after receiving a message mid-run
- Fixed WebFetch silently dropping page text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and takes an `offset` to read on
- Fixed a crash ("Maximum call stack size exceeded") when a response nested lists or quotes thousands of levels deep
- Fixed `/rewind` not listing a prompt sent while Claude was still working
- Fixed scheduled tasks (`/loop` with an interval, reminders) silently not coming back on resume once the conversation was compacted; covers compactions made from this version on
- Fixed scheduled tasks set in the foreground never firing after a ← or `/background` hand-off, and recurring ones firing an extra run on every resume, respawn or fork
- Fixed headless `--json-schema` runs exiting non-zero with `is_error: true` on a `success` result when the connection dropped after the structured output was already delivered
- Fixed plan mode letting the auto mode classifier approve non-read-only connector tools that carry a server-pushed ask policy
- Fixed a project `CLAUDE.md`, rule or `AGENTS.md` symlinked outside the working directories loading under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` or a `Read` deny rule
- Fixed URL allow and deny patterns with a wildcard inside an `xn--` host label matching differently from one process to the next
- Fixed an MCP server provided by your organization being relisted as your own after signing in or reconnecting, including from a late result in headless and SDK sessions
- Fixed `/ultrareview` dropping uncommitted changes without a warning on Windows when `git stash create` failed, and refusing them after a `git add -N` file was deleted or moved
- Fixed the `plansDirectory` setting's project-root check for paths that contain a backslash on macOS and Linux
- Fixed replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could appear a block at a time instead of streaming in
- Fixed the background daemon's log passing terminal control characters to the screen under `claude daemon run` and `claude daemon logs`; they now show as `\uXXXX` escapes
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a crafted, very long line of a session's error output freezing the runner for several seconds
- Fixed a plugin hook with a `.catch` being unloaded, and its `.catch` skipped, when the hook kept the hooks worker busy on a prompt or tool call
- Fixed a mod's `turn.step` result listing a tool call that a mid-response model fallback had discarded
- Fixed a Cowork cloud session's reply sometimes never finishing when its container restarted just after Claude sent a message or a file
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` and plugin loading refusing a hooks module that destructures an option named like one of its top-level functions
- Fixed `/ultrareview` failing to upload uncommitted changes when `core.safecrlf=true` is set in git's configuration
- Fixed the effort level changing when a flagged message is retried on a fallback model that has a different level saved in settings
- Windows: Fixed multi-line `!` shell blocks in skills and commands failing when the file is saved with CRLF line endings
- Fixed Claude Code hanging until killed when a `/permissions` tab was clicked while searching in fullscreen mode
- Fixed conversation compaction sometimes failing with a "null is not an object" error
- Fixed plugin hooks reading an empty `answer` on `turn.complete` for a subagent that hands its report back in auto mode
- Fixed a mod being unloaded without a message when a refresh followed its failed reload; its failure line now says the version loaded before is unloaded
- Fixed a mod's `prompt.submit` hook that drops a prompt after calling `next(e)` being ignored silently: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
- Fixed a mod's pane or band being redrawn without end when it followed its end over a tree that changed height at every drawing
- Fixed an image read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
- Fixed a case where a user-installed mod could get an organization's plugin unloaded; the mod is now the one unloaded
- Fixed `disableClaudeAiConnectors` and `allowedMcpServers` URL rules not being applied to some MCP entries declared in `.mcp.json`, plugins or agents
- Fixed a mod's inline pane being redrawn without end when its tree changed height at every drawing
- Fixed an `@`-mention under the read block or `--restricted` being able to read a file outside the working directories through a link changed mid-read
- Fixed Esc in the agents view confirming "Press enter again to restart this session — it isn't responding"; Esc now just reopens the session
- Fixed agent view losing a background session's `/loop` run count, countdown and live status line after the session enters a worktree that it creates
- Fixed `claude agents` sessions in manual permission mode asking for approval to read an image pasted into a reply or a new agent's prompt
- Fixed a deny or ask rule missing a command or path whose name came from a variable set as a prefix on `declare`, `typeset`, `export` or `readonly`
- Fixed Read deny rules not applying to image paths pasted or dragged into the prompt, or to file names listed for an @-mentioned folder
- Fixed a case where a user-installed mod could make an organization's guard skip its check; such a mod is now unloaded
- Fixed plugin hooks stalling each redraw when a mod draws a long multi-line text holding non-Latin characters
- Fixed repeated Ctrl+X in the agents view deleting the whole next section after the bottom session of a section was deleted
- Fixed You should know writing its notes in English regardless of the `language` setting
- Fixed a freeze after sending some very long messages
- Fixed a slowdown when expanding the transcript (ctrl+o) or resizing over large tool output that contains non-ASCII characters such as arrows, dashes or box-drawing
- Fixed `claude respawn` re-sending an earlier message to a backgrounded session that has no saved transcript instead of starting it with an empty conversation
- Fixed Esc after an `n:` or Ctrl+F search in the agents view moving focus to a section header, where Ctrl+X twice would delete every session in the section
- Fixed `claude agents` saving a slash command it could not deliver to a stopped session and then running it by itself the next time that session restarted
- Fixed `/ultrareview` uploading uncommitted changes unfiltered for files under a git filter driver named `unset` or `unspecified`; the upload now stops and asks you to rename the driver
- Fixed auto mode denials suggesting a permission rule that would skip the classifier for a whole tool or that Claude Code would ignore
- Fixed `claude --teleport` and `/teleport` deleting the files in a folder that had replaced a tracked file of the same name when you chose to stash: the stash is now refused, and says why
- Fixed Esc confirming agent view's "Press enter again to restart this session fresh" prompt
- Fixed agent view's `/loop` run count freezing and its countdown disappearing after `/clear`; the count now restarts with the new conversation
- Fixed `--channels` permission relay: a reply ID that repeats within a session is now ignored instead of approving a different prompt
- Fixed `/chrome` "Reconnect extension" not restoring browser tools after a failed Chrome connection, and added an explanation when it can't (anthropics/claude-code#98135)
- Fixed mods staying off for people who reach Claude through a gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`) and have no Anthropic account
- Fixed replies sent from `claude agents` just after a background session crashed being refused after 2 seconds: they are now retried for up to 12 seconds while the session restarts
- Fixed slash commands and answers to a multiple-choice question that `claude agents` could not deliver to a running session being saved and sent by themselves the next time it was restarted
- Fixed sandboxed commands that pipe a heredoc into another command (`cat <<EOF | python3`) asking for approval on every run
- Fixed `claude agents` failing with "Couldn't restart the background service" and background sessions stopping after a Homebrew upgrade (takes effect from the upgrade after this one)
- Fixed agent view's "restart this session fresh" re-sending an earlier message from the session instead of starting with an empty conversation
- Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some read-only commands (such as `rg` or `git grep`) whose arguments the shell would still expand as wildcards; these now prompt for approval
- Fixed `claude plugin test` refusing to run after an upgrade because of an out-of-date saved setting
- Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving certain commands whose variable names zsh reads differently from bash; these now prompt for approval
- Fixed a short form of a `git clone` option keeping the sandbox exemption from a git pattern such as `git *` in `sandbox.excludedCommands`; it is now treated like the long form
- Fixed the first feature-flag request of a session ignoring a proxy or API endpoint set in a project's settings
- Fixed `/ultrareview` of a local branch silently leaving uncommitted work out of the upload in a repository that keeps its branches outside `.git` (git 2.54+); it now refuses with an explanation
- Fixed cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending `/loop` wakeup or scheduled task; Claude is now told and can schedule it again
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway's retention sweep deleting a returning developer's identity row refreshed at the same moment, on PostgreSQL versions without the November 2025 fixes
- Fixed sandboxed Monitor tool commands skipping the permission prompt under sandbox auto-allow; they now follow your permission rules
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway failing to start when the certificate it presents to the identity provider has an empty subject
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway exiting with a bare "Invalid URL" when `store.postgres_url` can't be parsed; the error now names the setting and says what the URL may hold
- Fixed background agents failing with "Agent stalled" and Workflow tool subagents restarting from their prompt when a Mac woke from sleep
- Fixed slow or failed startup since 2.1.285 under SDK hosts such as the VS Code extension when managed settings deny reads of many paths on a slow filesystem (notably Windows drives under WSL)
- Fixed a response interrupted by computer sleep being treated as a stalled stream on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and custom gateways
- Fixed a freeze before the first request and in the `/sandbox` Config tab on Linux and WSL when a sandbox read rule such as `~/**/.env` covers a large folder
- Fixed skills not being found when asked for by the name in SKILL.md when their folder has a different name (for example a non-English name): the skill listing now shows both names
- Fixed a plan written in plan mode being lost when a cloud session's container restarted before the plan was presented
- Fixed the Bash tool occasionally losing shell aliases, functions and plugin PATH entries for a whole session when its first command ran seconds after startup on a new config directory
- Fixed unbounded memory use when an HTTP MCP server sends a very large response
- Fixed artifact operations failing in a Claude Code run started from inside a cloud session (for example `claude -p` run from the Bash tool)
- Fixed files sent from remote sessions sometimes being refused as "not the one approved" when four or more were sent at once
- Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session with `--continue` or `--resume <session-id>` in the terminal
- Fixed a marketplace named after another GitHub marketplace's download folder stopping that marketplace from downloading
- Fixed automatic compaction giving up with "Prompt is too long" when a Mac went to sleep while it was running
- Fixed the rewind menu (Esc Esc / `/rewind`) freezing for hundreds of milliseconds per keypress when the conversation contains a very large pasted stack trace or source file
- Fixed a subdirectory's AGENTS.md not being attached when a file under it is @-mentioned
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions resumed after a stopped runner failing with "missing but already registered worktree" when the sessions folder is a relative symlink
- Fixed a freeze when the secret scan or a permission prompt met long token-like text
- Fixed Bash permission checks not applying Read deny rules or the outside-directory read block to a wildcard in some option values of read-only commands
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` being read as 5 ms and cancelling remote dialogs at once; values with a unit suffix now fall back to `dialogExpiry`
- Fixed a stall when an MCP server's tool listing contains very long runs of combining characters
- Fixed two pastes that overlap in one prompt being sent to the model partly as typed text instead of as one pasted block
- Fixed Claude in Chrome's browser picker showing a message meant for Claude when the chosen browser is no longer connected, and the VS Code dialog's list going stale after a switch
- Fixed background subagents losing write and Bash access in their worktree after the main session enters or exits a different worktree
- Fixed background commands, the agents view and daemon workers sending telemetry and a feature-flag request to Anthropic behind a Claude apps gateway when no managed settings on the machine force gateway login
- Fixed `--restricted` (and `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`) sessions opening the cross-session messaging socket
- Fixed sessions moved to the background while idle reopening as "no saved transcript" after a restart or idle cleanup; they now resume their conversation
- Fixed background workers honoring `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` on respawn without the bypass-permissions disclaimer having been accepted
- Fixed Claude replying in an endless loop when a plugin's async Stop hook passes an unquoted script path under a folder with a space, such as Application Support
- Fixed a freeze of several seconds when secret masking met very long unbroken text
- Fixed some permission rules and safety checks not being applied to a tool call after a PreToolUse hook rewrote its input
- Fixed first launch asking to pick a login method again after `claude auth login` or with a credentials file already in the config directory
- Fixed file names containing line breaks being displayed incorrectly in file tool errors and permission prompts
- Fixed a large paste expanded in place being sent to the model as typed text after the next keystroke when it held accents stored as separate characters, as macOS file names do
- Fixed macOS `/login` reporting success when the keychain refused the new login and kept an old one it could not remove
- Fixed SDK hosts using `--include-partial-messages` seeing a reply stay open after the turn ended when its stream was cut, interrupted or fell back to non-streaming
- Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux running `ConfigChange` hooks and reloading settings mid-command when `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` does not exist
- Fixed errors reading "Premature close" instead of naming the missing program when a tool Claude Code runs, such as git or gh, is not installed (macOS, Linux)
- Fixed `/loop` and other recurring session-only scheduled tasks running an extra time after a sandboxed Bash command on Linux or after `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` was deleted
- Fixed edits to the file a symlinked settings file points at running without the settings-file permission question
- Improved MCP startup behind a network proxy: a server the proxy blocks (HTTP 403) is no longer retried three times
- Improved permission prompts from background agents to show the Ctrl+X Ctrl+K shortcut that stops all background agents
- Improved the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: Claude now gives the one command another person runs to install a mod you made, and writes it in a README's install section
- Improved the reply to `/plugin` in the desktop app's Code tab: it now says where to install and manage plugins there
- Improved the Bash changed-files view: when a chained command includes git merge, pull or checkout, it lists the files without full diffs
- Improved the Claude apps gateway's log when an upstream's cloud credentials or connection fail: the warning now ends with the underlying cause
- Improved the error shown when a cloud session is started without a claude.ai sign-in: it now names `claude auth login` and /login and no longer blames API-key authentication
- Improved the Read tool's message for binary files: it now points Claude to a skill or a shell command that can read the format
- Improved the error shown when a git config file stops the `/ultrareview` upload: it is about half as long and says what kind of file is the problem
- Improved the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload refuses a checkout: each known cause now has its own message, with a way to fix it
- Improved the Claude apps gateway to log a warning during the last 30 days before the certificate it presents to the identity provider expires
- Improved Claude in Chrome: a `browser_batch` call now gets 90 seconds, up from 60, before it is reported as timed out
- Improved the Claude apps gateway's browser sign-in pages: brand fonts, centered layout, and dark mode
- Improved responsiveness while resuming large sessions: timers, input and rendering keep running while the transcript loads
- Improved the / and @ suggestion lists: the selected row now starts with a ❯ pointer, so you can see it without color
- Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` to also skip the startup connection warm-up
- Changed Claude in Chrome so that a project's settings files can no longer turn it on; use `--chrome`, `/chrome` or your user settings
- Changed the Bash tool to ask for permission before running `pyright`, which is no longer treated as a read-only command
- Changed what a mod's `$.process.spawn` rejects with when another mod denies it after the child ran: it now says the call ran and a plugin withheld its result
- Changed the background daemon's log to write a multi-line message as one JSON-quoted line
- Changed skills and custom commands to refuse a `!` shell command that contains raw control characters other than tab and newline, with a message that shows where they are
- Changed `/artifacts`: opening an artifact in your browser now closes the list
- Changed Bash permission checks so that more forms of the `ps` command ask for approval instead of running without asking
- Changed plugin hooks so long text is clipped and logged instead of being refused or dropped silently
- Changed background sessions whose scheduled task is gone: they now move to Completed about 20 seconds later and can be updated or shut down when idle
- Changed the "Press ← again" confirm on a just-cleared prompt: a second ← no longer has to wait a second before it switches, and holding ← down now switches too
- Changed the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload fails at a git step: they name the step and what to try, and no longer repeat git's own error text
- Changed `/code-review` at medium effort to also report cleanup and CLAUDE.md conventions findings on models without tuned review settings, including Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
- Changed an in-process teammate's `agent_id` in Agent results to its agent ID (its `name@team` address stays in `teammate_id`); TeammateIdle hooks no longer fire from its subagents or forks
- Changed background sessions waiting on a scheduled wakeup (`/loop`): they are now left running through updates and low memory, where being restarted or shut down could silently lose the wakeup
- Changed `/model`, `/effort` and `/rename` sent from `claude agents` to a busy background session to apply right away, without a confirmation, instead of when the turn ends
- Changed the Claude apps gateway's minimum supported PostgreSQL version from 14 to 11
- Changed the interactive session's WebSearch budget to refill over time (100 calls/hour; `CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR` sets the rate, 0 turns it off) instead of ending after 200 calls
- Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS` so a repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` can no longer set it; shell, user and managed settings still can
- Changed `claude plugin update` on a plugin loaded from a directory to print just its reason, without the "Failed to update plugin" prefix, as for built-in plugins
- Changed the built-in `gh api` in cloud sessions: a host other than github.com set in `GH_HOST` or `GH_REPO` is now refused (use `--hostname` or a full URL), and stderr notes requests to other hosts
- Changed the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to turn off the web tools unless the agent needs them and to use the `auto` permission policy
- Self-hosted runners: Changed `claude --environment <id>` to create its session through the current Sessions API; printed and JSON session ids keep their session_… form
- [VSCode] Added a screen reader announcement, "Message queued.", when you send a message while Claude is working
- [VSCode] Added a way to review and run a plugin marketplace's install or update command from the Manage plugins dialog
- [VSCode] Fixed a blank chat you never typed into keeping a background Claude process running after you open a saved conversation in its place
- [VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code stopped unexpectedly during a save
- [VSCode] Fixed the branch switch dialog offering to switch when it could not check for uncommitted changes
- [VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt that arrived behind an open dialog taking keyboard focus, so a key pressed in the dialog could answer it
- [VSCode] Fixed sign-in and new sessions giving no clear reason when Claude Code cannot find or start its program
- [VSCode] Fixed the agent map showing a nested sub-agent with "Tool calls (0)" and placing the agents it starts under the main agent
- [VSCode] Improved Continue After Reload: tabs reopened after VS Code restarts its extensions now also finish a step the restart interrupted
- [VSCode] Improved file pills in messages: hovering one now shows the file's path from the project folder, so same-named files can be told apart
- [VSCode] Changed message timestamps to show by default (turn them off with the Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting)
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed turning off prompt suggestions through a cloud environment's environment variables having no effect in new cloud sessions
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the working indicator in a cloud session spinning on for several seconds after Claude's reply had finished; it now stops with the reply
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed History on a never-run routine's page still saying "No runs yet" after you pressed Run now; it now shows the new run
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed an unarchived cloud session looking as if Claude were still working until you sent another message
- [Remote Control] Fixed a computer that just started Remote Control taking up to a minute to appear in the Remote Control menu of a new session; it now appears within seconds
- [Claude Tag] Added fast mode in Slack: mention Claude with `!fast` to switch a thread to fast mode, moving it to Opus if needed, and `!fast off` to switch back; replies show (fast) while it's on
- [Claude Tag] Added the optional Path prefixes field when creating a custom connection in an access bundle, so its allow rule can cover only those paths instead of the whole host
- [Claude Tag] Fixed members with the Claude Tag Admin permission getting "Couldn't load memory files" on the Activity page's Memory tab; they can now read workspace and channel memory
- [Claude Tag] Fixed a workspace guest's Confirm on a Claude settings card in Slack removing its buttons for everyone; only the guest sees the refusal, and members can still confirm or cancel
- [Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled routines in Slack channels running on a model other than the channel's default; each run that starts a new session now uses the current default model
- [Claude Tag] Fixed GitHub repositories in an access bundle attached by a channel-name rule being refused in the channels the rule covers; Claude can now add, list and clone them there
- [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's notice in your direct messages when your own Claude plan's usage limit is reached: it shows within seconds and says when the limit resets
- [Claude Tag] Improved the earlier Claude in Slack app's reply when it can't start a session: it now says what failed and who can fix it, in full only once per thread
- [Claude Tag] Changed the channel instructions limit to 8,192 characters instead of bytes, so non-English text gets the same room, and added a character count beside Save on the Configure page
- [Code Review] Fixed blocking review comments sometimes opening with a "nit" label that contradicted their severity
- [Code Review] Fixed tips to comment "@claude review" being posted on fork and Manual-mode pull requests in organizations that have turned Code Review off

key_changes: 扩展了插件钩子系统：新增 serverToolUses、agentId、ceiling 等字段，并新增 ThemeKey 和 Color 类型，增强了 mod 与插件的扩展能力
修复了大量稳定性问题，包括长会话图片卡死、WebFetch 截断、深层嵌套崩溃、计划模式丢失、后台任务恢复失败等数十个缺陷
改进了 VSCode 扩展、云会话、远程控制、Claude Tag（Slack）等各平台体验，新增消息时间戳显示、屏幕阅读器播报等功能
调整了多项安全与权限行为，如 pyright 不再被视为只读命令、ps 命令更多形式需审批、CLAUDE_CODE 相关环境变量的限制范围变更
新增 claude attach/logs 会话名模糊匹配、managed-agents-onboard 配置命令、Claude apps 网关的 Deny 按钮等功能
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.290 是一个以修复为主的大型版本更新，修复了超过 80 个缺陷，涵盖插件系统、权限管理、后台任务、会话恢复、云会话、远程控制等核心领域。同时增强了插件钩子 API 的能力（新增多个字段和类型），改进了 VSCode 扩展和 Claude Tag（Slack 集成）的体验，并对部分权限和配置行为做了调整。此版本包含多项需注意的行为变更，如 pyright 和更多 ps 命令形式需要审批、部分环境变量的生效范围收窄等。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added an optional `offset` field to the WebFetch tool input for reading on through long pages
- Fixed failed Claude in Chrome tool calls dropping the result's `_meta`: when the result has one, `tool_use_result` is now `{ content, _meta }`, as for other MCP tools
- Fixed deny and ask rules missing `toolAliases` tools when written with a wildcard (`Bash*`), a match-all pattern (`Bash(**)`, also on the mapped name), or an input field also in `disallowedTools`
- Fixed a user message sent again under the same `uuid` being replayed (`--replay-user-messages`) while the first copy still waited for its turn; its replay now comes when a turn takes it
- Fixed `includePartialMessages` streams leaving a message without `message_stop` when the stream was cut, interrupted or fell back to non-streaming
- Changed `user_message_uuid`, `user_message_uuids` and `resume_reason` to also be set on a turn a restarted worker resumes from a permission answer or from tool calls still in flight
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.290

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.290
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.290
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.290
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.290
```

key_changes: WebFetch 工具输入新增可选 offset 字段，支持长页面分段读取
修复 Chrome 工具调用失败时丢失结果 _meta 字段的问题
修复通配符或匹配模式（如 Bash*、Bash(**)）编写的 deny/ask 规则遗漏 toolAliases 工具的问题

releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
## In plain words

This release is about **making the plugin "mods" safer and easier to see**. Mods are the small background helpers that watch what Claude does (for example, refusing to save a password into memory). Overnight we tested every one of them hard, fixed the weak spots, and added a few optional new abilities.

**Now on npm too.** `ruflo`, `claude-flow` and `@claude-flow/cli` are published as **3.52.0** (all three tags: latest, alpha, v3alpha). The plugin changes below ship inside them and as marketplace plugin updates. `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` was published first to fix `bun add ruflo` (see below).

## Install fix: bun

`bun add ruflo` failed with "@claude-flow/codex missing version 3.0.3" (#3736). ruflo 3.51.1 asks for exactly codex 3.0.3, but only 3.0.2 existed on npm. npm hid this because it uses a bundled copy; bun does not. We published `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3`, then installed `ruflo` with bun in a clean folder: it now installs and runs (`ruflo v3.51.1`).

## What got safer

- **Secret guards no longer give up on big inputs.** Before, 32 guards could be skipped by sending a very large or deeply nested message. They now refuse such input instead. In our test run (3,182 attempts) the number of ways around a guard went from **788 to 0**.
- **Console:** at the "write" level Claude could run a shell command through the console. That is closed. "Always allow" can no longer skip your chosen control level, and auto-confirm never answers questions about network, spending or deleting.
- **Memory guard (agentdb):** it now catches secrets hidden with look-alike characters, and also checks the file you point `memory_import` at.
- **More secret-carrying tools are guarded**, and a status file that is really a link or folder is never read.

## What is new (all off by default)

Turn these on in `ruflo-mods` options if you want them:
- `agentTrim` — hides agent types you never use. Measured saving: **4,236 tokens** per session.
- `toolHints`, `deliveryScreen`, `capabilityProbe`, `sessionRollup`, `compactCarry` — extra hints, message screening, a self-check, a counts-only history, and carrying swarm/claims state through `/compact`.
- Console: a **Mods** section on the Room screen, clearer "waiting for you" banners, and a `drive.sh` script that lets a headless Claude click through the console for testing.

## Numbers

- Guard test holes: 788 → 0
- Plugin smoke checks: 47 of 47 pass
- Console tests: 1,106 pass
- Cost of all mod hooks on an unrelated tool call: about 19 microseconds

## What is NOT included

- No dependency pin changes. No leaf package source changed since 3.51.1.
- Draft PR #3751 (guard overlap) is not merged: it would make some guards weaker and needs a human decision.
- Still open: see the follow-up issue.

## How to update

npm: `npx ruflo@latest` or `bun add ruflo`. Plugins:

```
claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
claude plugin update ruflo-mods@ruflo --scope user
claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo --scope user
claude plugin update ruflo-agentdb@ruflo --scope user
```
(44 plugins changed in total; do the others the same way.) Then restart Claude Code.

72 pull requests, #3706 to #3784.

releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
## Fix: `bun add ruflo` failed (#3736)

`ruflo` 3.51.1 depends on exactly `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3`, but that version had never been published to npm (latest was 3.0.2). npm did not notice because it uses a copy bundled inside the package; bun looks the version up in the registry and stopped with "missing version 3.0.3".

This release publishes `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` (the same source that was already in the repo). Nothing else changed.

**Checked:** 242 codex tests pass, the package contents are clean (120 files), and `bun add ruflo` in an empty folder now installs 586 packages and `ruflo --version` prints v3.51.1.

**Lesson for releases:** before merging a pin to a leaf package, check that `npm view <package>@<version>` returns it.

key_changes: 修复了执行 `bun add ruflo` 时因缺少 `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` 版本而失败的问题
发布了与仓库中已有源码一致的 `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` 版本到 npm
验证了 242 个 codex 测试全部通过，包内容干净（120 个文件）
确认 `bun add ruflo` 现在可以正常安装 586 个包，`ruflo --version` 可正确输出 v3.51.1
总结了发布经验：在合并叶子包的版本锁定前，需先确认 `npm view <package>@<version>` 中存在该版本
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本修复了 `bun add ruflo` 安装失败的问题。原因是 `ruflo` 依赖的 `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` 版本从未发布到 npm 注册表，而 bun 会在注册表中查找该版本导致报错。本次将已存在于仓库源码中的 `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` 正式发布到 npm，恢复安装功能，除此之外无其他变更。

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次扫描共覆盖 20 个仓库、61 个 Issue 信号，识别出 4 组跨仓库共性问题簇，其中核心 AI 生成流程/会话运行时阻断（workflow_runtime）与工具权限/协议安全（auth_permission、tool_call_protocol）占比最高，且多数缺陷以"静默失败"形式呈现——无报错、无重试、无部分结果标记，导致用户得到错误结果或数据丢失而不自知。此外，会话状态损坏（session_state）在 goose、opencode、anthropic SDK 等多个仓库中以"上下文压缩后卡死/会话丢失"的高影响形态反复出现。
global_highlights: 跨仓库最严重共性是「核心 AI 生成/Agent 运行主流程被阻断」：173 个 Issue 分布在 40+ 仓库，涵盖路线图/规格文档生成失败、Model/Provider 调用 400 错误、run_agent 授权失败等，直接使用户工作流不可用（P0）。
「静默失败」是贯穿各仓库的普遍缺陷模式：phoenix 的 span 静默丢弃与付费静默出错、skills 引用不存在工具静默退回、opencode 流式掉线无提示卡死、claude SDK 会话数据静默丢失等，用户长期拿不到任何错误信号。
「工具权限/协议」层面的安全与可靠性问题高发：continue 的 subagent 以 allow-all 覆盖用户权限、claude-agent-sdk-typescript 的 Write/Edit 绕过全部权限机制、MCP 工具参数类型/数值/诊断信息在多语言 SDK 中被破坏。
「上下文压缩（compaction）后会话损坏」是新的跨仓库高影响问题簇：goose 与 opencode 均出现压缩后模型忽略新消息、HTTP 400 死循环或永久卡死，anthropic SDK 系出现压缩增量复活已清除值、工具可用性失步等连锁缺陷。

top_pain_points.review_reason: 两项均为 confirmed bug，都直接阻断用户的核心工作流（生成路线图/规格文档），且 #1424 反复失败、#1452 导致生成功能完全不可用，是用户在真实使用中反复遇到的阻断性故障。

source_issues.title: Roadmap generation failed with exit code 1
source_issues.evidence: Windows 上点开 Roadmap 点 Generate 并启用分析后，Discovery Stage 约 40% 处失败，报 'Roadmap generation failed with exit code 1'，路线图无法生成，直接阻断核心功能。

source_issues.title: cannot using my own custom API Profiles for antropic compatible provider
source_issues.evidence: 使用自定义 anthropic 兼容 API Profile 时，各阶段反复返回 400 错误 'some error happen, please contact admin'，Phase 'spec_writing' 三次重试 Agent 均未创建 spec.md，最终生成失败。

source_issues.title: Agent escapes worktree isolation via cd to parent project path
source_issues.evidence: 任务日志显示 Agent 正确进入 worktree 后执行 'cd /e/projects/x && git add ... && git commit ...'，被隔离的提交和文件修改落到主项目，隔离系统失效；另有相关问题：worktree 创建可能把 remote 设为默认分支导致改动进错分支。

source_issues.title: executeSql on PostgreSQL: attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' silently returns NULL / matches no rows while SQLite returns the value
source_issues.evidence: 同一 SQL 在 SQLite 返回 gpt-4，在 PostgreSQL 上 silent NULL/0 行，工具拒绝信息反而引导用户使用该拼写；无错误、无 partial 标记。

source_issues.title: Ingest replicas can deadlock each other on trace/session range updates (PostgreSQL)
source_issues.evidence: 两个 ingest replica 以相反顺序加行锁触发 deadlock，被中止的 span 回滚且不被重试，SDK 已返回 200，忙会话行被长时间持锁。

source_issues.title: Ingest replicas race on creating ProjectSession and Trace rows (unique violation drops the span)
source_issues.evidence: 两个 replica 对新 session/trace 做 check-then-insert 竞态，触发唯一约束冲突后 span 被静默丢弃，OTLP 请求已 200；作者在真实生产看到每天 10^5 span 的部署出现该问题。

source_issues.title: Playground can't run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra on AWS Bedrock: default temperature=1 is always sent and rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra 及 gpt-5.6-sol 每次默认运行都因强制发送 temperature:1.0 被 400 拒绝，温度控件无法清空，只有去掉温度才能运行。

source_issues.title: Playground AWS Bedrock fails with ParamValidationError when a prompt replays a tool call (all models)
source_issues.evidence: 含 AI tool call 回放的消息被原样塞进 Bedrock content block，botocore 报 ParamValidationError，GPT-6 系列与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 均失败，属于关键对话内工具调用场景无法执行。

source_issues.title: phoenix-evals AnthropicAdapter structured output fails on Claude Opus 5.5 (Bedrock): forced tool_choice rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: AnthropicAdapter 硬编码 tool_choice={"type":"tool"}，被 Opus 5.5/Fable 5.1 以 400 拒绝，generate_object 结构化输出在这些模型上完全失败。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Cannot add LLM profile with advanced settings
source_issues.evidence: 使用 Advanced 标签配置本地 LLM 保存报 litellm.BadRequestError 'LLM Provider NOT provided'；选 Provider connection 后可保存但发起聊天仍报同一错误，主聊天功能不可用。

top_pain_points.review_reason: 大量 issue(含 #49433 59 评论、#52905、#51241、#50627 等)表明免费层模型在官方客户端内因缺失凭据、权限 deny、桌面应用、第三方前端等多种场景被同一误导性错误阻断,且报错文案不指向真实原因,用户无从自查。这是主流程(发送任意消息)的高频阻断,直接导致免费模型不可用并伴随排查成本,满足 P0 强用户影响证据。

top_pain_points.topic: create_evaluator 的 tuple 返回计分逻辑静默损坏 label/explanation 与分数
top_pain_points.summary: create_evaluator 装饰的验评估器返回 tuple 时，字符串元素按词数而非文档约定的 (score,label,explanation) 位置归类，导致两个同桶元素互相覆盖（静默数据丢失），甚至文档自身的示例也会算错；bool 被视为数字且以最后出现者作为分数。结果在无警告情况下产生错误的评估标签与分数，影响实验与可靠性评估结论。
aliases: 数据库被锁导致启动阻塞
top_pain_points.review_reason: 评估器的标签和分数是用户决策的基础数据，tuple 转换在无任何错误下产生错误且不稳定的评估结果，直接破坏评估结论与实验可比性，属于关键功能的结果静默出错。

source_issues.title: create_evaluator's tuple-to-Score conversion classifies strings by word count, not position, silently corrupting label/explanation
source_issues.evidence: tuple 分支按词数<=3判为 label、>=4判为 explanation 而非按位置，同桶第二项静默覆盖第一项，且文档自带 length_check 示例也被算错，现有测试因样例未撞桶而未覆盖。

source_issues.title: create_evaluator tuple score depends on element order
source_issues.evidence: 返回 (0.8,True) 得 1.0 而 (True,0.8) 得 0.8，bool 被当数值、以最后出现者作为分数，违背预期（数字为分数、bool 为标签）。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Run-failure banner disappears after reload (error invisible, user message left unanswered)
source_issues.evidence: 失败事件被持久化为 ConversationErrorEvent，但失败横幅只存在内存 store；刷新后用户气泡悬挂无回复无错误 UI，execution_status=error 仍在服务端。报告称是手机端最常见的困惑来源。

source_issues.title: Context freeze after compaction: new user messages excluded from requests, model repeats stale responses (v1.52.0 desktop)
source_issues.evidence: 自动compaction后模型忽略所有新用户消息并重复旧状态，用户必须新建会话；inputTokens连续两轮delta=+0且cacheRead≈99%证明请求字节级相同，用户消息已被持久化但被排除出请求。

source_issues.title: Bedrock provider: a session that contains an elicitation fails every later turn ("text field in the ContentBlock … is blank")
source_issues.evidence: 会话经过 elicitation 后每一轮都因 ActionRequired 转成空白 Text 块被 Bedrock 拒绝，重试约两分钟看起来像挂起随后失败，会话无法恢复必须新建。

source_issues.title: Tool pair summarization runs silently, reuses full-compaction threshold for its cutoff, injects agent-only messages with no historical marker
source_issues.evidence: 工具对摘要被当成用户输入注入无历史标记，模型可能重新执行数天前已完成的任务而忽略实际查询，形成难以诊断的循环，且无任何状态提示。

source_issues.title: Error： SSE read timed out
source_issues.evidence: 53 条评论,SSE 读取超时导致请求失败。

source_issues.title: SSE stream silently dropped mid-response hangs session/subagents forever — chunkTimeout has no default on the openai path
source_issues.evidence: 流式中途被静默丢弃,会话/子代理永久挂起,openai 路径 chunkTimeout 无默认值。

source_issues.title: OpenCode gets stuck indefinetly when running terminal commands.
source_issues.evidence: 执行终端命令时无限卡住。

source_issues.title: Desktop 5-min Headers Timeout
source_issues.evidence: 桌面端 5 分钟头部超时。

top_pain_points.topic: 应用启动即崩溃，无法打开
top_pain_points.summary: macOS 上升级到 2.8.0 BETA 5 后，应用启动时抛出未捕获异常 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND（缺少 @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider 包），进程直接崩溃，应用无法打开，而旧版 2.7.6 正常。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 启动即崩溃导致应用完全无法使用，属于主流程彻底阻断（P0 级影响），但因单条 issue（count=1）按规则不能标 P0，故取 P1。影响为 100% 用户不可用，是明确的启动崩溃痛点。

source_issues.title: A javascript error occurred in the main process 2.8.0 BETA 5
source_issues.evidence: macOS 打开 2.8.0 BETA 5 即抛 'Cannot find package @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider'，Uncaught Exception，应用无法启动，Expected behavior 为 'That the app opens up'，旧版正常。

source_issues.title: Installation fails: stale lock file causes 'another process is currently installing' after timeout
source_issues.evidence: 完整复现：尝试1超时、尝试2因锁文件失败，随后误报 'Installation complete'，实际执行 'Error spawning Claude process: Executable not found in $PATH: "claude"'。含完整 workflow 日志链接和期望/实际行为对比。

source_issues.title: Recurring mid-session SIGSEGV of native linux-x64 binary across 2.1.210-2.1.278
source_issues.evidence: Linux 原生二进制在健康会话中段（运行约 1h27m 后）SIGSEGV，跨 9 个发布版本复发；二进制带剥离无符号，无法解析栈，且无 Node 运行时回退方案。

source_issues.title: Claude Code 2.1.243 crashes with SIGSEGV on startup (null pointer dereference)
source_issues.evidence: Claude Code 启动即空指针解引用 SIGSEGV 崩溃。

source_issues.title: Native installer segfaults in newlocale/free during startup on glibc 2.44
source_issues.evidence: glibc 2.44 系统（Arch/CachyOS）上原生安装器在启动时 newlocale/free 分段错误，用户无法启动工具。

source_issues.title: Activation fails if the YAML extension is not present.
source_issues.evidence: 扩展启动时尝试向 VS Code 写入 yaml.schemas 设置，因未安装 Red Hat YAML 扩展而抛 CodeExpectedError，Continue 无法启动；安装 YAML 扩展后才正常。

source_issues.title: Activation fails if there's a non-standard color palette in place.
source_issues.evidence: 用户 Color Theme 非标准时 activate 抛 TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'editor.background')，扩展完全无法启动；改回 vanilla 主题才能运行。

source_issues.title: Startup failures report no logs because there is no viewLogs method
source_issues.evidence: 启动失败时 'Show Logs' 按钮无任何效果，控制台报 command 'continue.viewLogs' not found，用户无法查看任何日志定位激活失败。多个启动失败 issue 都因无日志而难以排查。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: "could not find vendor" error on v1.4.452 despite correct configuration in .env and config.yaml
source_issues.evidence: the CLI returns a could not find vendor error. Even manually specifying --vendor Ollama --model gemma3:4b results in no AI vendors configured. Workaround: Downgrading to version v1.4.322 resolved the issue... using the exact same configuration files.

source_issues.title: [Question]: model discovery errors and failure-cached empty catalogs
source_issues.evidence: When both configured vendors' ListModels return errors... the actual CLI... returns handled=true and nil error. GetModels therefore retains the empty result as a successful cache. When one vendor errors only on its first ListModels call... the next GetModels still returns the cached empty catalog without invoking ListModels again.

top_pain_points.topic: HTTP 类型 MCP 服务器健康检查/连接失败，无法配置使用
top_pain_points.summary: HTTP 型 MCP 服务器（含 Z.AI）在健康检查和连接测试时返回 HTTP 400，因为健康检查用了 GET 而许多 MCP 服务器只支持 POST 初始化；用户无法成功配置和使用这些服务器，且无清晰错误提示。
aliases: MCP 服务器工具不可用
anthropic SDK API 兼容性破坏
动态 MCP 集成失效
top_pain_points.review_reason: MCP 健康检查用错误的 HTTP 方法导致配置与连接反复失败、关键集成功能不可用，属真实用户影响；单条且为特定集成场景，标 P2。

source_issues.title: HTTP MCP servers return 400 Bad Request during health check (Z.AI and others)
source_issues.evidence: HTTP 型 MCP 服务器健康检查用 GET 而非 MCP 要求的 POST initialize，导致 400，连接测试失败，用户无法配置使用这些服务器，且无明确报错说明失败原因。

source_issues.title: mcp: no reconnect after network change/socket reset; stale Error until server process is killed
source_issues.evidence: 网络变化/重连后 MCP 无重连,服务进程不杀掉则一直报错。

source_issues.title: mcp: remote MCP servers that fail once are never retried until service restart
source_issues.evidence: 一次失败后远程 MCP 永不重试,直到重启。

source_issues.title: 批量 MCP 参数损坏
source_issues.evidence: SSE 传输下批量 MCP 工具调用参数被破坏。

source_issues.title: MCP tool forwarding rounds numeric arguments before the server receives them
source_issues.evidence: decodes the model's JSON into map[string]any, which converts numbers through float64 ... A server receiving a call with {\"value\":9007199254740993} instead sees {\"value\":9007199254740992}. A precise decimal is rounded, 1e-400 becomes zero.

source_issues.title: MCP adapter discards structured-only error details
source_issues.evidence: When CallToolResult contains IsError:true, empty Content, and StructuredContent {\"message\":\"try again\"...}, the public tool ... returns the generic error `tool returned an error`. The same structured payload is correctly converted when IsError is false.

source_issues.title: MCP content conversion rejects equivalent media types and skips supported resources
source_issues.evidence: ToBlock rejects an ImageContent with MIMEType IMAGE/PNG or image/png; charset=binary, although the base media type is already supported. ResourceToBlock can also skip the first supported resource.

source_issues.title: Schema conversion drops oneOf when the same node already has anyOf
source_issues.evidence: transformSchema clears OneOf unconditionally but copies it to AnyOf only when AnyOf is empty. A node containing both loses the entire oneOf restriction ... a JSON Schema validator also accepts \"a\".

source_issues.title: MCP TypedDict schemas misclassify Required/NotRequired under postponed annotations
source_issues.evidence: Generated schema required array is ['limit','query'] instead of ['query']; calling tool with {query:'test'} returns isError=true and handler never runs. Reverse case allows missing required arg. Triggered purely by 'from __future__ import annotations'. Reproduced on 0.2.163, Python 3.13.14, MCP 2.2.0 on asyncio and Trio with full public-API repro.

source_issues.title: Cross-version zod schemas crash tools/list in createSdkMcpServer (connected but zero tools)
source_issues.evidence: Issue #491 具体描述了错误栈：z.record() 构建于 zod 4.6.5 调用 ctx.deferred.push，而捆绑版本 4.4.3 上下文无 deferred 字段导致 TypeError，整个 tools/list 序列化失败，服务器被报为 connected 但零工具。

signals.topic: 核心 AI 生成流程（路线图/规格文档）失败被阻断
signals.summary: 用户在 Windows 上点击生成路线图时失败（exit code 1），在 Analysis 到约 40% 时中断；另一个用户在配置自定义 API Profile 后，分析各阶段持续返回 HTTP 400 错误，spec_writing 三次重试全部失败，导致规格文档无法生成、关键功能不可用。
signals.review_reason: 两项均为 confirmed bug，都直接阻断用户的核心工作流（生成路线图/规格文档），且 #1424 反复失败、#1452 导致生成功能完全不可用，是用户在真实使用中反复遇到的阻断性故障。

source_issues.title: Roadmap generation failed with exit code 1
source_issues.evidence: Windows 上点开 Roadmap 点 Generate 并启用分析后，Discovery Stage 约 40% 处失败，报 'Roadmap generation failed with exit code 1'，路线图无法生成，直接阻断核心功能。

source_issues.title: cannot using my own custom API Profiles for antropic compatible provider
source_issues.evidence: 使用自定义 anthropic 兼容 API Profile 时，各阶段反复返回 400 错误 'some error happen, please contact admin'，Phase 'spec_writing' 三次重试 Agent 均未创建 spec.md，最终生成失败。

source_issues.title: A javascript error occurred in the main process 2.8.0 BETA 5
source_issues.evidence: macOS 打开 2.8.0 BETA 5 即抛 'Cannot find package @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider'，Uncaught Exception，应用无法启动，Expected behavior 为 'That the app opens up'，旧版正常。

signals.topic: Agent 逃逸 worktree 隔离，把提交写到父项目错误位置
signals.summary: 在隔离 worktree 模式下运行任务时，Agent 读取上下文中的绝对路径后执行 cd 到父项目根目录再做 git add/commit，导致提交和文件修改落在主项目而非隔离工作树，隔离机制失效，可能污染错误分支和主仓库。
signals.review_reason: 隔离机制失效导致 git 提交写入错误位置，可能覆盖/污染主项目与错误分支，造成数据放错地方甚至丢失，是明确的用户数据安全问题；虽单条但影响严重，标 P1。

source_issues.title: Agent escapes worktree isolation via cd to parent project path
source_issues.evidence: 任务日志显示 Agent 正确进入 worktree 后执行 'cd /e/projects/x && git add ... && git commit ...'，被隔离的提交和文件修改落到主项目，隔离系统失效；另有相关问题：worktree 创建可能把 remote 设为默认分支导致改动进错分支。

signals.topic: HTTP 类型 MCP 服务器健康检查/连接失败，无法配置使用
signals.summary: HTTP 型 MCP 服务器（含 Z.AI）在健康检查和连接测试时返回 HTTP 400，因为健康检查用了 GET 而许多 MCP 服务器只支持 POST 初始化；用户无法成功配置和使用这些服务器，且无清晰错误提示。

source_issues.title: HTTP MCP servers return 400 Bad Request during health check (Z.AI and others)
source_issues.evidence: HTTP 型 MCP 服务器健康检查用 GET 而非 MCP 要求的 POST initialize，导致 400，连接测试失败，用户无法配置使用这些服务器，且无明确报错说明失败原因。

signals.topic: 列内拖拽排序不生效且无法持久化
signals.summary: 在 kanban 列内拖拽卡片调整上下优先级时，鼠标松开后卡片立即回到原位，用户自定义顺序既无效也不持久，只能跨列移动，无法在列内排序。
signals.review_reason: 列内排序是看板常用操作，拖拽后位置不持久导致用户排序操作白白丢失，明显降低体验；单条且为 UI 边缘功能，标 P2。

source_issues.title: Drag and drop ordering within a column doesn't persist.
source_issues.evidence: macOS 2.7.4 下列内拖拽卡片到底部再拖回顶部，松开鼠标卡片弹回底部，位置不持久，用户无法在列内排序。

signals.topic: PostgreSQL 多副本部署下静默数据丢失或静默返回错误结果
signals.summary: 在 PostgreSQL 多副本部署中，span 采集会静默失败，已被 SDK 回复 200 的 span 因死锁或唯一约束冲突而被丢弃；同时 executeSql MCP 工具在 PostgreSQL 上对嵌套 JSON 路径断言静默返回 NULL/0 行。所有失败均无错误提示、无重试、无部分标记，导致用户得到错误答案或长期数据缺失而不知情。
signals.review_reason: 用户在真实 PostgreSQL 多副本自托管部署中会静默丢失已确认提交的 span，或在 executeSql 中得到错误的 NULL 查询结果，且无任何报错提示，长期破坏数据完整性与分析正确性，属于关键数据/主流程静默失败。

source_issues.title: executeSql on PostgreSQL: attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' silently returns NULL / matches no rows while SQLite returns the value
source_issues.evidence: 同一 SQL 在 SQLite 返回 gpt-4，在 PostgreSQL 上 silent NULL/0 行，工具拒绝信息反而引导用户使用该拼写；无错误、无 partial 标记。

source_issues.title: Ingest replicas can deadlock each other on trace/session range updates (PostgreSQL)
source_issues.evidence: 两个 ingest replica 以相反顺序加行锁触发 deadlock，被中止的 span 回滚且不被重试，SDK 已返回 200，忙会话行被长时间持锁。

source_issues.title: Ingest replicas race on creating ProjectSession and Trace rows (unique violation drops the span)
source_issues.evidence: 两个 replica 对新 session/trace 做 check-then-insert 竞态，触发唯一约束冲突后 span 被静默丢弃，OTLP 请求已 200；作者在真实生产看到每天 10^5 span 的部署出现该问题。

signals.topic: AWS Bedrock provider 集成故障导致 Playground 与 evals 无法运行模型
signals.summary: Playground 的 AWS Bedrock provider 默认总是发送 temperature=1，被 OpenAI GPT-6 系列模型以 400 拒绝且温度控件无法清空；回放 ai tool call 时消息内容格式错误触发 ParamValidationError（所有模型）；phoenix-evals 的 AnthropicAdapter 强制 tool_choice tool 被 Claude Opus 5.5/Fable 以 400 拒绝导致结构化输出失败。多类 Bedrock 后端调用被阻断。
signals.review_reason: 用户通过 Playground 和 evals 在 AWS Bedrock 上选择最新模型时，默认参数或工具调用会直接 400/参数校验失败，导致关键生成与评估流程被阻断且几乎无可用工作绕过（温度无法清除、回放是常态操作），明显降低核心功能可用性。

source_issues.title: Playground can't run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra on AWS Bedrock: default temperature=1 is always sent and rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra 及 gpt-5.6-sol 每次默认运行都因强制发送 temperature:1.0 被 400 拒绝，温度控件无法清空，只有去掉温度才能运行。

source_issues.title: Playground AWS Bedrock fails with ParamValidationError when a prompt replays a tool call (all models)
source_issues.evidence: 含 AI tool call 回放的消息被原样塞进 Bedrock content block，botocore 报 ParamValidationError，GPT-6 系列与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 均失败，属于关键对话内工具调用场景无法执行。

source_issues.title: phoenix-evals AnthropicAdapter structured output fails on Claude Opus 5.5 (Bedrock): forced tool_choice rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: AnthropicAdapter 硬编码 tool_choice={"type":"tool"}，被 Opus 5.5/Fable 5.1 以 400 拒绝，generate_object 结构化输出在这些模型上完全失败。

signals.topic: 成本追踪静默计费错误：新模型按旧前缀模型费率计费、非有限 token 计数清零有效成本
signals.summary: 内置成本模型使用无锚定的子串匹配，新发布且 ID 为旧模型前缀扩展的模型（如 claude-opus-5-5→claude-opus-5）会静默按旧模型费率计费，且跨度成本只在采集时计算一次，清单更新后不重算；另有 OTLP span 携带 NaN/Inf token 计数会把其他两个有效计数清零。错误计费在 UI 中不可见。
signals.review_reason: 成本数据是用户计费与成本洞察的核心，静默按错误费率计费或把有效计数清零会让用户对真实花费产生严重偏差，且因 UI 不显示任何错误而无法察觉，直接造成成本误判。

source_issues.title: Cost tracking silently bills new models at an older prefix model's rates (claude-opus-5-5 → claude-opus-5)
source_issues.evidence: claude-opus-5-5 span 静默按 claude-opus-5 费率(输入输出高25%)计费，直到清单更新；跨度计费只在采集时算一次，已存在部署仍携带错价 span，且 UI 无感知。

source_issues.title: Non-finite token count zeroes valid counts in cost calculation
source_issues.evidence: 任一 token 计数为 NaN/Inf 时 get_aggregated_tokens 返回 (0,0,0)，丢弃另两个有效计数，SpanCostDetailsCalculator 用 0 计算兜底成本。

signals.topic: create_evaluator 的 tuple 返回计分逻辑静默损坏 label/explanation 与分数
signals.summary: create_evaluator 装饰的验评估器返回 tuple 时，字符串元素按词数而非文档约定的 (score,label,explanation) 位置归类，导致两个同桶元素互相覆盖（静默数据丢失），甚至文档自身的示例也会算错；bool 被视为数字且以最后出现者作为分数。结果在无警告情况下产生错误的评估标签与分数，影响实验与可靠性评估结论。
signals.review_reason: 评估器的标签和分数是用户决策的基础数据，tuple 转换在无任何错误下产生错误且不稳定的评估结果，直接破坏评估结论与实验可比性，属于关键功能的结果静默出错。

source_issues.title: create_evaluator's tuple-to-Score conversion classifies strings by word count, not position, silently corrupting label/explanation
source_issues.evidence: tuple 分支按词数<=3判为 label、>=4判为 explanation 而非按位置，同桶第二项静默覆盖第一项，且文档自带 length_check 示例也被算错，现有测试因样例未撞桶而未覆盖。

source_issues.title: create_evaluator tuple score depends on element order
source_issues.evidence: 返回 (0.8,True) 得 1.0 而 (True,0.8) 得 0.8，bool 被当数值、以最后出现者作为分数，违背预期（数字为分数、bool 为标签）。

signals.topic: LLM/Agent 档案编辑器设置被静默丢弃或误派生
signals.summary: 在 Add/Edit LLM Profile 或 Agent Profile 界面中，已展示的设置项在保存时被静默丢弃（如温度参数、当前模型名未随新选择更新），或重复名称时静默禁用保存而不给出原因，用户配置与保存结果不一致。
signals.review_reason: 档案配置界面存在多处静默丢配置/误派生/无提示问题，导致用户保存的配置与预期不符，影响 LLM 使用配置流程，但单点影响较轻。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Add LLM Profile shows the agent's current LLM options (such as temperature) but saves the new profile without them
source_issues.evidence: 展示的 LLM 选项未保存到新档案，用户以为已配置但实际丢失。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Add LLM Profile keeps the name derived from the initial model after the user picks a different model
source_issues.evidence: 用户改选不同模型后档案名仍沿用初始模型派生的名称，保存结果与界面不一致。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LLM and agent profile editors silently disable Save for a duplicate name, with no message
source_issues.evidence: 重名时保存按钮被静默禁用且无任何提示，用户困惑为何无法保存。

signals.topic: 自定义/高级 LLM 连接配置后无法正常发起对话发起失败
signals.summary: 用户按高级方式或自定义厂商（如代理 Ollama 的 9Router、自定义 openAI 兼容端点）配置 LLM 提供方后，保存或发起对话时被 litellm 报 'LLM Provider NOT provided' 错误阻断，主聊天流程不可用。
signals.review_reason: 两个 issue 直接阻断用户发起聊天/使用自定义 LLM 连接这一主流程，属于反复失败与关键功能不可用，用户影响明确。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Cannot add LLM profile with advanced settings
source_issues.evidence: 使用 Advanced 标签配置本地 LLM 保存报 litellm.BadRequestError 'LLM Provider NOT provided'；选 Provider connection 后可保存但发起聊天仍报同一错误，主聊天功能不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Unable to use 9Router as a custom LLM connection proxying Ollama
source_issues.evidence: 自定义连接代理 Ollama（含 'ollama-local' 前缀）时 litellm 报 'LLM Provider NOT provided'，应传所选 provider 而非模型前缀，导致该自定义连接完全无法使用。

signals.topic: 插件/应用安装更新报错被误导性网络文案掩盖真实原因
signals.summary: 插件或 Canvas 应用安装/更新在服务端失败时，界面仅显示 'Disconnected (check URL or network)'，隐藏了服务端真实错误信息，用户无法定位问题根因。
signals.review_reason: 用户执行安装/连接测试失败时看到的是误导性通用文案而非真实错误，导致排查受阻、反复困惑，属于体验显著下降。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Plugins and Apps: install/update errors say "Disconnected (check URL or network)" instead of the server's reason, and plugin errors toast twice
source_issues.evidence: 插件安装非法 source 或应用拉取不可达 Git URL 失败时，服务端明确报 'Failed to fetch plugin source' 但 UI 显示 'Disconnected (check URL or network)'，且插件错误 toast 重复出现两次。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: A failed STDIO MCP connection test says "Check the URL and server type" and hides the real error
source_issues.evidence: STDIO 服务器命令不存在时 UI 显示 'Check the URL and server type'（服务器并无 URL），后端返回的 'No such file or directory' 精确实错被丢弃。

signals.topic: 对话运行失败状态在刷新/移动端恢复后消失，用户消息被静默忽略
signals.summary: 运行以 LLM/工具失败结束后，失败横幅仅存于内存 store，页面刷新或移动端恢复后失败信息不可见，用户消息既无回复也无错误提示，读起来像代理静默忽略请求，移动端最受影响。
signals.review_reason: 关键错误信息在刷新后丢失，主流程失败的反馈缺失，导致代理静默忽略请求的假象，是用户可感知的明确缺陷，尤其反复发生在移动端。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Run-failure banner disappears after reload (error invisible, user message left unanswered)
source_issues.evidence: 失败事件被持久化为 ConversationErrorEvent，但失败横幅只存在内存 store；刷新后用户气泡悬挂无回复无错误 UI，execution_status=error 仍在服务端。报告称是手机端最常见的困惑来源。

signals.topic: Anthropic 结构化输出请求的系统提示多代币导致 prompt cache 失效，用户被按写档级（~1.25x）重复计费而非读档级（~0.1x）
signals.summary: Anthropic 路径在每次调用的结构化输出系统提示中内嵌一个随机 output_tag_id，使此前缀字节每次变化，导致 ephemeral prompt cache 永远无法命中，系统前缀每次都被按昂贵的写档级重新计费（含重试），抵消了该热路径为降低成本加入的缓存控制。
signals.review_reason: 用户在使用 Anthropic 路径的结构化输出时，因缓存前缀每次被随机 token 破坏而无法命中 ephemeral cache，导致本应享受 ~0.1x 读档价格的系统前缀每次按 ~1.25x 写档价格重计费（含重试）。这是明确的、可量化的成本损失，直接关系到用户账单，属于主流程高频路径上的计费异常。

source_issues.title: Random per-call json_output tag busts the Anthropic prompt cache in structured-output blocks
source_issues.evidence: issue 明确给出影响：'the system prefix ... is re-billed at the write tier (~1.25x) instead of the read tier (~0.1x) every call, including retries'，即每次结构化输出调用都按昂贵档位计费，缓存形同虚设，造成用户明显的成本损失。

signals.topic: Copilot run_agent 运行创作者最新图版本而非用户已安装版本，导致'没有访问某 graph 版本'的授权失败，阻断工作流
signals.summary: Copilot 运行库 agent 时以 active/latest 版本启动图，而非用户库里已安装的版本；当创作者发布更新的且用户无权限访问的版本时，运行以 'You do not have access to graph #… vN' 失败。一周生产 trace 中 27 个工作流有 10 个命中。
signals.review_reason: 用户（尤其是市场 agent 的订阅者）运行已安装的库 agent 时，后台却去执行没有权限的更新版本，导致明明库里显示的是旧版本、运行却以授权错误失败。10/27 工作流的高命中率证明这是高频主流程阻断，直接影响用户能否跑通 Copilot 工作流。

source_issues.title: Copilot run_agent runs the creator's latest graph version instead of the user's installed version
source_issues.evidence: issue 明确：'It starts the graph's active (latest) version ... the run fails with "You do not have access to graph #… vN"'，且 'an automated marketplace audit hit this on 10 of 27 workflows'，标注 bug。

signals.topic: Copilot web_search 返回的答案常引用 [6] 及以上编号，但工具只返回前 max_results（默认 5）条无编号的结果，导致回答的大多数来源无法提供引用清单、snippet 恒为空
signals.summary: Copilot 的 web_search 工具返回带引用标记的答案文本，但只返回前 max_results（默认 5，上限 20）条无编号的 url_citation，且自称会提供的 snippet 字段始终为空。抽样 278 次调用中 82% 的答案引用了比返回结果数量更高的编号，导致 agent 无法为它报告的大多数内容给出来源。
signals.review_reason: 用户依赖 web_search 的引用来源来核实和追溯 Copilot 回答，但绝大多数答案引用的来源被截断，且承诺的 snippet 恒为空，使关键的可信来源功能实质失效。这是断言式功能的关键质量缺陷（可信度下降），影响明显但未完全阻断主流程，故评 P2。

source_issues.title: Copilot web_search drops most of the sources its answer cites
source_issues.evidence: issue 提供量化证据：278 次调用中 229 次（82%）引用的来源编号超过返回结果数、0 次返回非空 snippet；标注 bug。

signals.topic: Graphiti memory 的 cross-encoder reranker 默认模型 gpt-4.1-nano 将被 OpenAI 于 10 月 23 日下线，未设置 reranker_model 时 warm-context 检索将静默退化
signals.summary: 平台的 Graphiti memory 在未显式设置 reranker_model 时默认使用 gpt-4.1-nano，而 OpenAI 将于 10 月 23 日关闭该模型；届时这些 reranker 调用（默认经 OpenRouter）会开始失败，静默降级 warm-context 检索质量。
signals.review_reason: 开启 Graphiti memory 且未自定义 reranker_model 的用户，在模型下线后其检索相关调用会静默失败，导致记忆/上下文召回这一关键功能质量下降。虽为外部模型下线触发的近期失效，但影响真实用户的功能可用性，且是确凿的代码默认值缺陷，保留为 P2。

source_issues.title: Graphiti reranker defaults to gpt-4.1-nano, which OpenAI shuts down on October 23
source_issues.evidence: issue 给出配置链引用并明确影响：'the reranker calls to start failing once OpenAI retires the model, which would quietly degrade warm-context retrieval'，涉及 Graphiti memory 功能用户。

signals.topic: RSS 块在 run-once（单次运行）模式下仍等待完整轮询间隔，给每次读取 feed 的 agent 运行额外增加约 60 秒延迟
signals.summary: RSS 块即使设置为只运行一次，也会先等待其轮询间隔再返回，导致每次读取一个 feed 的 agent 运行被无谓地拖慢约 60 秒。
signals.review_reason: 使用 RSS 块且以 run-once 模式运行的 agent 每次都会无谓地多等约 60 秒，导致运行时延显著增加、体验下降。虽非阻断但为高频路径上的明显性能浪费，保留为 P2。

source_issues.title: RSS block sleeps its full polling interval even when set to run once
source_issues.evidence: issue 明确：'waits out its polling interval even in run-once mode ... adds about 60 s to every run of an agent that reads a feed once'，标注 bug。

signals.topic: 会话上下文化后模型卡死/忽略新用户消息，必须重开会话才能恢复
signals.summary: 在自动 compact 或工具对摘要后，会话上下文被损坏或不一致，导致模型反复重复旧状态、忽略后续新用户消息，会话只能通过关闭重开或新建会话恢复。多个 issue 展示了不同的根因路径：compaction 把用户消息标记为 agent-only 导致 messages_since_kickoff 扫描到陈旧 kickoff 点；Bedrock 会话中的 elicitation 产生的空白 ContentBlock 毒化后续每一轮，导致每次请求都 ValidationException 失败（约两分钟重试后报错）；tool-pair summarization 静默注入无历史标记的 user-role 摘要使模型反复重新执行旧任务。共同点是用户工作流被阻断、需要手工重开会话。
signals.review_reason: 主流程被阻断：compaction(12521)、Bedrock deferral(12681)、compaction summarization(12690) 都会让模型停止响应当前输入并重复陈旧状态，用户必须放弃当前会话新建会话，这是明显且高频的核心体验失败。

source_issues.title: Context freeze after compaction: new user messages excluded from requests, model repeats stale responses (v1.52.0 desktop)
source_issues.evidence: 自动compaction后模型忽略所有新用户消息并重复旧状态，用户必须新建会话；inputTokens连续两轮delta=+0且cacheRead≈99%证明请求字节级相同，用户消息已被持久化但被排除出请求。

source_issues.title: Bedrock provider: a session that contains an elicitation fails every later turn ("text field in the ContentBlock … is blank")
source_issues.evidence: 会话经过 elicitation 后每一轮都因 ActionRequired 转成空白 Text 块被 Bedrock 拒绝，重试约两分钟看起来像挂起随后失败，会话无法恢复必须新建。

source_issues.title: Tool pair summarization runs silently, reuses full-compaction threshold for its cutoff, injects agent-only messages with no historical marker
source_issues.evidence: 工具对摘要被当成用户输入注入无历史标记，模型可能重新执行数天前已完成的任务而忽略实际查询，形成难以诊断的循环，且无任何状态提示。

signals.topic: Provider 请求失败阻断正常使用：Bedrock 图片尺寸校验、Copilot 吊销 token 缓存导致长时间不可用、Bedrock 缓存 token 计费重复
signals.summary: 多个 provider 相关请求级缺陷直接阻断用户使用：Amazon Bedrock 在多图请求中任一张图超过 2000px 就会整个请求 ValidationException 失败且无自动缩放或清晰报错；GitHub Copilot provider 在服务端吊销 token 后仍持续复用本地到期的缓存 token，导致 403 长达约 24 小时不可用；Bedrock cache tokens 被重复计入 total usage 造成使用量/计费展示翻倍。这些都会造成用户请求直接失败、长时间服务不可用或计费数据错误。
aliases: Bedrock 图片过大请求失败
signals.review_reason: 三个 provider 级缺陷都落到具体用户场景：Bedrock 多图请求合法输入即整体失败(12575)、Copilot 吊销 token 后约 24h 无法使用且难诊断(12512)、Bedrock 缓存 token 计费翻倍造成用量/成本展示错误(12583)，均直接影响请求成功率和计费准确性。

source_issues.title: Amazon Bedrock request fails when an image exceeds the 2000px limit in multi-image requests
source_issues.evidence: 多图请求中任一张图某维度超过 2000px 即整体 ValidationException 失败，无自动缩放也无清晰用户报错，请求直接失败。

source_issues.title: GitHub Copilot provider keeps using a revoked cached Copilot token (403) until local expiry
source_issues.evidence: 服务端吊销 token 后 provider 仍复用缓存到本地 expires_at，每条请求 403，provider 最长约 24h 不可用；其他 Copilot 客户端正常，只能手动删 info.json 恢复。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Bedrock cache tokens are added twice to total usage
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock 缓存 token 被两次加入 total usage，导致展示的使用量/成本翻倍，计费数据不准确。

signals.topic: Provider 流式连接/超时/掉线导致会话或子代理无限卡住且无错误提示、无超时重试
signals.summary: Provider 流式连接/超时/掉线导致会话或子代理无限卡住且无错误提示、无超时重试,须手动重启恢复
signals.review_reason: 多个 issue 显示流式连接超时/掉线/无默认 chunkTimeout 时,会话或子代理会无限卡在 thinking/执行状态,无错误提示也无法恢复,用户必须手动重启。这是主流程的中断式体验,高频且直接影响关键功能可用性。

source_issues.title: Error： SSE read timed out
source_issues.evidence: 53 条评论,SSE 读取超时导致请求失败。

source_issues.title: SSE stream silently dropped mid-response hangs session/subagents forever — chunkTimeout has no default on the openai path
source_issues.evidence: 流式中途被静默丢弃,会话/子代理永久挂起,openai 路径 chunkTimeout 无默认值。

source_issues.title: OpenCode gets stuck indefinetly when running terminal commands.
source_issues.evidence: 执行终端命令时无限卡住。

source_issues.title: Codex/OpenAI 子代理频繁卡死无超时重试
source_issues.evidence: 27 条评论,子代理/任务无超时重试导致会话永久挂起。

source_issues.title: Desktop 5-min Headers Timeout
source_issues.evidence: 桌面端 5 分钟头部超时。

source_issues.title: TUI crash: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'U.r')
source_issues.evidence: 无常量流中超时导致的卡死。

signals.topic: OpenCode 免费层(Console/自由模型)请求失败并报误导性 free tier can only be used from within OpenCode,即便请求就来自官方客户端,阻断所有免费模型使用
signals.summary: OpenCode 免费层(Console/自由模型)请求失败并报误导性 free tier can only be used from within OpenCode,即便请求就来自官方客户端,阻断所有免费模型使用
signals.review_reason: 大量 issue(含 #49433 59 评论、#52905、#51241、#50627 等)表明免费层模型在官方客户端内因缺失凭据、权限 deny、桌面应用、第三方前端等多种场景被同一误导性错误阻断,且报错文案不指向真实原因,用户无从自查。这是主流程(发送任意消息)的高频阻断,直接导致免费模型不可用并伴随排查成本,满足 P0 强用户影响证据。

source_issues.title: Error from provider (Console): OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode
source_issues.evidence: 59 条评论,任意模型均失败;用户已在官方 CLI 内仍被拒。既有缺失凭据又有多场景误报。

source_issues.title: 官方桌面应用免费模型被拒
source_issues.evidence: 官方桌面应用内请求免费模型仍被拒,日志反复出现 Failed to drain Session 与 AI.Error.Authentication。

source_issues.title: Free models fail when shell or read permissions are denied
source_issues.evidence: deny shell/read 权限即导致免费模型被当作外部来源拒绝,改为 allow 立即可用,始终复现。

source_issues.title: 自定义 agent deny shell 破坏免费层
source_issues.evidence: 自定义主 agent 加 shell deny 后所有免费模型请求失败,去注释即恢复。

source_issues.title: docs: misleading free-tier auth error has no documented fix
source_issues.evidence: 缺 Console 凭据导致此报错,错误文案误导为 CORS/来源问题,文档无记录,恢复命令仅在第三方评论中找到。

signals.topic: 上下文压缩(compaction)后会话被 400/死循环卡死、丢失任务目标或无法恢复
signals.summary: 上下文压缩(compaction)后会话被 400/死循环卡死、丢失任务目标或无法恢复
signals.review_reason: 上下文压缩是长会话的必经路径,而多个 issue 表明压缩可能把会话直接卡死到 HTTP 400/永久失败,或让 agent 丢失任务目标继续乱做。导致长时间任务成果丢失且无法恢复,是显著的成本损失与关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: compaction: 1M-context sessions never auto-compact before the provider returns HTTP 400, and the 400 is not treated as context overflow
source_issues.evidence: 超大上下文会话不自动压缩直到 provider 返回 400,400 又不被识别为上下文溢出。

source_issues.title: Session permanently fails after compaction when the retained tail starts mid-turn (Claude thinking blocks cannot be modified)
source_issues.evidence: 压缩后保留尾部从回合中间开始,会话永久失败。

source_issues.title: session: permanently stuck on HTTP 400 after a failed step; compaction also fails
source_issues.evidence: 失败步骤后永久卡在 HTTP 400,连压缩也失败。

source_issues.title: 自动压缩后丢失任务目标
source_issues.evidence: 自动压缩后 agent 未经确认继续执行并丢失原始任务目标。

signals.topic: 项目目录被移动/删除后,项目列表残留无法清理,Desktop 打开即崩溃、TUI 会话挂起
signals.summary: 项目目录被移动/删除后项目列表残留无法清理,Desktop 打开即崩溃、TUI 会话挂起
signals.review_reason: 用户重命名/迁移项目目录是常见操作,但残留项目无法清理,Desktop 打开即崩溃且无法自行恢复,是明显的关键功能不可用与崩溃体验。

source_issues.title: tui: cannot remove stale projects from /open list; desktop crashes on non-existent project
source_issues.evidence: 项目目录删除后 /open、/project 列表残留无法删除;Desktop Settings>Projects 打开残留项崩溃(ClientError 500)需手动重启。

source_issues.title: desktop: renderer crash loop on launch when restored tab references deleted session
source_issues.evidence: 恢复的标签引用已删除会话,启动即渲染进程崩溃循环(TypeError 读取 directory)。

source_issues.title: desktop: missing or inaccessible project folder breaks project requests
source_issues.evidence: 项目目录缺失或不可访问导致项目请求失败。

source_issues.title: Desktop fails to load sessions: no such column project_id
source_issues.evidence: 桌面端会话加载失败,报 no such column project_id。

signals.topic: MCP 服务器连接失败后不重连/不重试,需重启服务恢复
signals.summary: MCP 服务器连接失败后不重连/不重试,需重启服务,进程不杀错误持续
signals.review_reason: MCP 是用户接入外部工具的核心方式,连接失败后既不重连也不重试,只能靠重启服务恢复,导致工具功能长时间不可用;部分 case 甚至永久破坏会话。影响了依赖 MCP 工具的关键工作流。

source_issues.title: mcp: no reconnect after network change/socket reset; stale Error until server process is killed
source_issues.evidence: 网络变化/重连后 MCP 无重连,服务进程不杀掉则一直报错。

source_issues.title: mcp: remote MCP servers that fail once are never retried until service restart
source_issues.evidence: 一次失败后远程 MCP 永不重试,直到重启。

source_issues.title: 批量 MCP 参数损坏
source_issues.evidence: SSE 传输下批量 MCP 工具调用参数被破坏。

signals.topic: MCP 工具适配层破坏数据与诊断信息（数值舍入、错误详情丢失、媒体类型误拒）
signals.summary: Go MCP 适配层存在三类数据损坏：工具调用参数经 float64 解码后数值被舍入（如 9007199254740993 变成 ...992）；仅含 structuredContent 的错误结果被丢弃成通用 'tool returned an error'，关键诊断信息丢失；大小写/带参数后缀的等价 MIME 类型被拒绝导致合法图像/资源被跳过。用户传给后端的数据被篡改或无法获取准确的错误原因。
signals.review_reason: MCP 工具是用户把能力暴露给模型的关键路径：入参数值被静默舍入会破坏数据完整性（后端拿到错值），结构化的失败原因被压成通用错误让排障变难，合理媒体类型被拒则使合法文件直接不可用。三者都造成用户可见的错误结果或调试成本。

source_issues.title: MCP tool forwarding rounds numeric arguments before the server receives them
source_issues.evidence: decodes the model's JSON into map[string]any, which converts numbers through float64 ... A server receiving a call with {\"value\":9007199254740993} instead sees {\"value\":9007199254740992}. A precise decimal is rounded, 1e-400 becomes zero.

source_issues.title: MCP adapter discards structured-only error details
source_issues.evidence: When CallToolResult contains IsError:true, empty Content, and StructuredContent {\"message\":\"try again\"...}, the public tool ... returns the generic error `tool returned an error`. The same structured payload is correctly converted when IsError is false.

source_issues.title: MCP content conversion rejects equivalent media types and skips supported resources
source_issues.evidence: ToBlock rejects an ImageContent with MIMEType IMAGE/PNG or image/png; charset=binary, although the base media type is already supported. ResourceToBlock can also skip the first supported resource.

signals.topic: 会话累积/重放导致状态损坏或运行时崩溃
signals.summary: 对话累积与回放路径存在多处缺陷：ContentBlockUnion.ToParam 遇到未建模的未知响应块会发生 nil-pointer panic，replay 下一轮对话直接崩溃；compaction 累积时 JSON 刷新忽略空值，已清除的 content/encrypted_content 会被遗留并随 ToParam 重新发送；重播的 preview event_start 会擦除已完成的 agent 消息并可能在后续清空。
signals.review_reason: 会话累积/重放是多轮对话与状态管理的核心。未知响应块触发 nil-pointer 崩溃会直接中断主流程，compaction 残留已清除字段会让用户发出的请求携带过期内容，preview 重播擦除已完成消息则造成会话数据丢失。均为影响明显的运行异常。

source_issues.title: GA content-block replay panics on unknown response variants
source_issues.evidence: ContentBlockUnion.ToParam unconditionally calls a method on the result of AsAny(), which is nil for an unmodelled type. A conversation replay through Message.ToParam therefore panics, for both non-streaming responses and accumulated streaming messages.

source_issues.title: Compaction deltas can revive cleared values when accumulated messages are replayed
source_issues.evidence: A delta with content:null or content:\"\" can leave a previous summary in RawJSON and ToParam. json.Marshal(message.ToParam()) sends the previous strings instead of null.

source_issues.title: Replayed preview starts erase completed managed-agent messages
source_issues.evidence: A replayed event_start with the same ID replaces a completed agent.message with an empty preview ... After step 3 the message is absent from AgentMessages. The buffered message should remain authoritative.

signals.topic: SSE 流式响应解码缺陷导致首条消息或错误静默丢失
signals.summary: SDK 的 SSE 解码器在三种情况下丢失流式数据：行首 UTF-8 BOM 会被当作字段名的一部分，导致首条 message_start 事件或 error 事件被吞掉；仅使用 CR 换行的合法 SSE 流（不含 CRLF/LF）完全无法产出任何事件；混合行尾可能合并 JSON 负载引发解析错误。用户将缺失整条流式响应/错误且无法察觉。
signals.review_reason: 流式响应是 Anthropic SDK 的核心主路径，这两处解码缺陷会无提示地吞掉整条首条消息或整个错误响应（首条消息没了、失败静默），用户拿不到应有的数据也没收到报错，属于直接的用户可感知的数据缺失问题。

source_issues.title: A leading UTF-8 BOM hides the first streamed message event or error
source_issues.evidence: A response beginning with `﻿event: message_start` loses that event; a response beginning with `﻿event: error` finishes without reporting the server error. A BOM before the first data field similarly discards its payload.

source_issues.title: SSE decoding drops CR-only streams and can merge events with mixed line endings
source_issues.evidence: The default SSE decoder ... recognizes LF/CRLF but not standalone CR. Valid CR-delimited streams yield no events. Mixed endings can merge JSON payloads and raise a parse error.

signals.topic: 压实块中的工具增删被工具运行器忽略导致工具可用性失步
signals.summary: Go 工具运行器的 availableToolNames 只处理系统消息中的增删，忽略 assistant compaction 块内 tool_changes 记录的增删，导致已移除的本地工具在恢复会话后仍被执行、或已重新添加的工具未被恢复，工具调用走错分支。
signals.review_reason: 会话压实是长度控制常用手段，恢复后工具集与服务器实际状态不一致会使应不可用的工具仍在本地执行，导致调用结果错误甚至意外的本地副作用；属明确但低频率的功能行为缺陷。

source_issues.title: Tool runner ignores additions and removals retained in compaction blocks
source_issues.evidence: restoring an assistant compaction block whose tool_changes contains a tool_removal referencing weather leaves the registered local weather tool executable. A subsequent tool call runs locally instead of receiving the existing unavailable-tool result.

signals.topic: JSON Schema 转换丢失 oneOf 约束导致输入验证被放宽
signals.summary: transformSchema 在节点已含 anyOf 时无条件清空 oneOf 且不写入 allOf，导致同一节点的 oneOf 约束整体丢失，SDK 生成的会话接受原本应被拒绝的输入值，放宽了验证边界。
signals.review_reason: 当工具输入 schema 同时含 anyOf 与 oneOf 时约束被静默丢弃，用户期望的严格校验被放宽、非法输入被接受；属低频但会产生错误结果的边界缺陷。

source_issues.title: Schema conversion drops oneOf when the same node already has anyOf
source_issues.evidence: transformSchema clears OneOf unconditionally but copies it to AnyOf only when AnyOf is empty. A node containing both loses the entire oneOf restriction ... a JSON Schema validator also accepts \"a\".

signals.topic: MCP 工具转换在参数精度、schema 约束和错误诊断上破坏调用行为
signals.summary: Java SDK 的 BetaMcp.mcpTool 将 MCP 工具定义/参数转换给 Anthropic 时，三个独立缺陷导致用户 MCP 调用不可靠: 十进制与指数数值经 Double 中间转换丢精度/溢出下溢为 Infinity 或 0.0（#419）；转换丢失 additionalProperties 显式约束使本应被拒绝的未声明属性被放行（#421）；当工具以 structuredContent 返回错误时仅凭 content 构建异常消息，导致诊断信息丢失且消息为空（#423）。
signals.review_reason: 用户通过 SDK 集成 MCP 工具时，参数数值会被静默损坏、schema 校验被放宽、工具报错的诊断信息丢失。这些都直接影响真实调用的正确性与排障能力，属于主流程失败/关键功能数据异常，且有三个相互独立、均有复现的 issue 佐证。

source_issues.title: MCP tool input conversion rounds decimals and overflows or underflows exponents
MCP tool conversion drops explicit additionalProperties restrictions
source_issues.evidence: mcpTool 复制的 schema 丢失 additionalProperties=false/true，转换后的 schema 允许源 schema 禁止的未声明属性，破坏参数校验。

source_issues.title: MCP tool errors with only structuredContent lose their diagnostic payload
source_issues.evidence: CallToolResult(content=[], isError=true, structuredContent={"message":"try again",...}) 抛出 message 为空的 AnthropicException，结构化诊断被丢弃，用户无法得知失败原因。

signals.topic: 认证令牌异步刷新并发问题导致无关请求被取消或挂起
signals.summary: CachingAccessTokenProvider 的异步令牌刷新存在并发缺陷: 取消请求者之一返回的 future 会取消所有共享同一次 refresh 的调用者（#427）；当 provider 在返回 future 之前同步抛异常时，保留的 in-flight future 永远无法 settle，导致连接其上的调用者挂起（#425）。
signals.review_reason: 这两个缺陷均发生在认证令牌刷新这一关键路径，直接导致并发环境下用户的 API 请求被错误取消或永久挂起，属于主流程可用性受损。

source_issues.title: Cancelling one asynchronous token request cancels other callers sharing its refresh
source_issues.evidence: 取消任一并发调用者返回的 future 会令共享同一次异步 refresh 的其他调用者收到 CancellationException 而非 token; 还能提前触发下一次强制刷新。

signals.topic: Bedrock 流式解码在空 chunk/控制帧时崩溃
signals.summary: Bedrock 流式解码器 _chunk_bytes_to_sse 对 chunk.get("bytes") 为 None 或缺失字节键时无条件调用 raw.decode()，抛出 AttributeError，立即崩溃正在运行的 Bedrock 流，用户无法获得流式响应。
